newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY MAIZE, WHEAT FUTURES PLUMMET ON RAIN.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY MAIZE, WHEAT FUTURES PLUMMET ON RAIN.

text.p: Hungarian maize and wheat futures went mostly limit-down as long-awaited rain arrived, Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) traders said on Thursday.
"The rain caused the prices to fall and there was no upward from international markets either," said Mihaly Otvos of brokerage OTP Forex.
Maize prices dropped the daily allowed 400 forints per tonne for all but the July maturity which lost 320 forints to end at 20,000 forints.
Deferred milling wheat termins also went limit-down while of the nearest ones July lost 100 forints, August 270 and September 370 forints.
Feed barley dropped for maturities until October, feed wheat from August to December while virtually tradeless sunflower seed finished lower for November and December.
In the absence of buyers, turnover totalled a meagre 199.3 million forints or 416 lots, of which milling wheat accounted for 271 lots.
